dedupe_keys.name: ifc catalogue of nature based solutions for infrastructure projects draft for discussion 2023

description: The IFC Catalogue of Nature-based Solutions for Infrastructure Projects gives sector-specific examples of solutions that conserve, enhance or restore ecosystems within larger infrastructure projects and provide infrastructure-type services that displace or complement grey engineering. The International Finance Corporation prepared it with Conservation International in 2023 as a draft for discussion and a companion to IFC's Biodiversity Finance Reference Guide, where such solutions count as eligible use of proceeds. It is organised into chapters for water utilities, mining and renewable and other energy, sets out the business case for each solution, and invites companies to share further case studies, as the catalogue is meant to evolve. Coverage is emerging markets worldwide. Format and access: a free 80-page PDF. Licence: not stated. Caveats: it is a draft and not exhaustive, and examples are qualitative. It helps climate adaptation and capacity planning studies identify nature-based options for utilities, mines and power projects. Related catalogue records are the ACT on NBS tools catalogue and the French catalogue of nature-based solution projects.
